campaign_objective: Contain the Japanese invasion (Marco Polo Bridge Incident), preserve industrial core, unify warlords through national focus or subjugation, push Japanese forces out of mainland Asia, and reclaim Manchuria and Korea.

strategic_priorities.defense_in_depth: Do not fight in the open plains of Hebei where Japanese armor and air dominates. Fall back to the Yellow River and Yangtze River lines with entrenched infantry.
strategic_priorities.economy_and_equipment: Extreme shortage of rifles and artillery. Build military factories in inland mountains (Sichuan, Yunnan). Prioritize basic infantry equipment production. Avoid expensive mechanized or tank research.
strategic_priorities.warlord_integration: Focus tree 'Subjugate the Warlords' or United Front diplomacy. Puppet or annex Shanxi, Guangxi, and Yunnan to secure manpower and steel/tungsten resources.
strategic_priorities.coastal_defense: Station dedicated port-guard garrisons on every single port from Qingdao to Guangzhou to defeat Japanese naval invasions on the beaches before they disembark.
